prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1214; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for the claim file. Can you confirm you're comfortable continuing?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Can you walk me through what happened at the intersection in Pasadena?

A: I was heading through on the green light, going maybe thirty-five miles an hour. A pickup coming from my right ran the red and clipped the driver's side of my car. I didn't see him until he was already in the intersection.

Q: Did you have any time to react before the impact?

A: Not really. I tapped the brake, but it all happened very fast. The airbags didn't deploy, but my head snapped sideways and then back.

Q: Did you feel any injury right after the collision?

A: My neck was stiff almost right away, but I figured it would loosen up. By that evening it was hurting when I turned my head, and I had a dull ache across my shoulders.

Q: Have you sought medical care since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next morning. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and some anti-inflammatories. I've also been scheduled for physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms today?

A: Yes. Turning to check my blind spot is harder, and sitting at my desk for long periods makes it worse. Some days are better than others.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt at the time of the collision?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Only that I'm glad nobody else was seriously hurt. The other driver's insurance has been contacted, and I've kept copies of the police report and my medical bills.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up once we've reviewed the documentation. Is there anything you'd like to add before we end the call?

A: No, that covers it. Thanks.
